plan: In a single-round sealed bid auction with a private value of $10, my optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. This protects me from overpaying while still giving a chance to win. Since the auction uses an ascending clock and I'll exit at my sealed bid, I want to bid close to, but not exceeding my value. I'll bid $9.9 to create a small buffer and potentially win if others bid similarly conservatively.
